$comment: Permanent entries are findings that are safe by construction; each says why. plugin-network-boundary-baseline.json pins this list, and on pull requests the count may not exceed the base branch's baseline.

permanent.reason: Delegate hands the user's environment to the coding agent it runs (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) so the agent can use its own sign-in, and reads backend profile settings from it. The Claude adapter also reads Claude Code's user, project and managed settings.json files (under CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR or HOME, the project's .claude/ and the managed settings directory) and copies ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL and the provider routing variables from their env blocks into the child's environment. Not flagged by the directory in 3.1.0 or 3.4.0; an explicit allowlisted child environment would remove it.
